name: Surajit Chakrabarty
role: Building efficient context for Machine Learning & Systems
bio: I study how large models reason, fail, and can be made more *reliable* — sitting somewhere between machine learning research and the systems that run it.
This site is my open notebook: experiment logs, reading notes, and write-ups, published as I go.

projects.title: Very Small Language Models for Indic Languages
projects.summary: Building compact language models for Indian languages — exploring tokenisation for Indic scripts, data curation for low-resource languages, and how much capability fits into a model small enough to run on-device.

projects.title: System One Decision Models
projects.summary: Fast, intuitive decision models — systems that act in a single pass, without step-by-step deliberation — and the question of when such “System 1” decisions can be trusted.
